root_cause: Memory leak in connection pooler during heavy parallel embedding inserts.
resolution: Applied hotfix v2.4.1 to recycle idle pool connections and capped max connection backlog to 100.

root_cause: Redis cache replica desynchronization caused spurious token validation failures.
resolution: Re-synchronized Redis replica cluster and increased replication timeout threshold from 2s to 5s.

root_cause: Upstream SMTP service provider throttled outbound order confirmation emails.
resolution: Configured dynamic traffic splitting across secondary SMTP backup provider.
